knowledge_base_entries.title: Great dodecacronic hexecontahedron
knowledge_base_entries.snippet: A nonconvex uniform dual with recorded long-edge length 2.4 normalized units and short-edge length 1.5 normalized units.

knowledge_base_entries.title: Great ditrigonal dodecacronic hexecontahedron
knowledge_base_entries.snippet: A nonconvex uniform dual with recorded long-edge length 2.8 normalized units and short-edge length 1.6 normalized units.

polyhedron_articles.title: Great dodecacronic hexecontahedron
polyhedron_articles.body: The Great dodecacronic hexecontahedron is cataloged here with two distinct edge measures. The long edge is 2.4 normalized units and the short edge is 1.5 normalized units.

polyhedron_articles.title: Great ditrigonal dodecacronic hexecontahedron
polyhedron_articles.body: The Great ditrigonal dodecacronic hexecontahedron is listed with a long edge of 2.8 normalized units and a short edge of 1.6 normalized units.
